'''January 2000 Boca Raton tournament (9 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boca Raton, FL on 9 January 2000. [[Andrew Ledwith]] won it. It is known from Andrew Ledwith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d169">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-11-boca-raton-fl-1-9-00d169/ boca-raton-fl-1-9-00], DeckTech (Andrew "Gadget" Ledwith, 11 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-11-boca-raton-fl-1-9-00d169/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Boca Raton, FL
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Ledwith]]
